minor.issue: test_real_slip_image_extracts_weight_and_vehicle failed once in full parallel run, passes standalone — known LLM-vision flake, not related to opening stock

ui_bugs.issue: React duplicate-key console error ('Encountered two children with the same key') at /entries surfaces as a red error banner in dev build; pre-existing, not caused by opening stock. keyExtractor uses e.id (uuid) so source is likely a sub-component or stale duplicate data

issues: testID 'office-nav-opening stock' contains a space (derived from label.toLowerCase()); works on web but fragile — suggest slugifying, e.g. office-nav-opening-stock

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — some component passes pointerEvents as a prop; migrate to style.pointerEvents (warning seen on /office/login)

action_items: Fix duplicate React key warning on /entries (identify offending list; error text says keys non-unique)
Slugify office sidebar testIDs (replace space in 'office-nav-opening stock')
Migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents (RN web deprecation)
Housekeeping (optional): inventory grade filter chips polluted with legacy test grades (FIFO-GRD-*, ITER4_*, TEST_*) from past iterations — consider cleanup or filter to catalog grades
critical_code_review_comments: OpeningStockForm paste parser: for >=5 cells, grade=nums[3] is accepted without numeric check — input '8,1250,2500,2500,40' silently stores grade='2500'. Minor; consider validating grade is non-numeric.
entry_date is not validated before new Date(...).toISOString(); invalid input throws RangeError caught by generic catch → error toast. Acceptable but a friendlier inline validation would help.
REMOVE hidden when rows.length===1 means user can never delete the last card; clearing fields is the only way back to 0 items. Matches spec (submit disabled at 0) — OK.
